说明: 真火星地面材质样块库（74_多站样块.py 库 生成，勿手改）。每块是一张可平铺的细节图块：反照率细节（逐通道均值 1）+ 高度（米，零均值，去平面和 0.5 m 低频），都做了 Moisan 周期分解（贴花除外）。类型定义、放置线索见 类型；站点见 站点；方法和质量见 docs/地面材质/样块库.md。

格式.albedo: PNG RGB8，存 A/gain（第 0 行在南，同 57/61）；解码 A = 像素/255 × gain。gain = 全图最大值向上取到 0.01（同 61.albedo_gain），不截断
格式.height: <id>_height.bin：int32 宽、高，然后 float32 高度（米）行优先，第 0 行在南（同 61）
格式.size_m: 整块边长（米）；px_m 格距（米）
格式.可信频段: Navcam 全分辨率：高度只到约 1 cm 波长（更细的是平滑），反照率到约 2 mm；Navcam 半分辨率：高度约 2 cm、反照率约 4 mm；Mastcam-Z 110 mm：高度约 3–5 mm、反照率 0.5–1 mm；好奇号 Navcam：见站点 note
格式.albedo_contrast: 反照率细节 log 亮度的标准差
格式.slope_rms_1cm_deg: 高度平滑到 1 cm 后的坡度 RMS
格式.lam_dom_cm: 2 cm–0.5 m 内方差最大的 1/4 倍频程带中心
格式.psd_beta: 2D 高度谱在 2–20 cm 的斜率
格式.rgb_rel_station: 块平均线性 RGB（分离后的反照率）÷ 本站整片有效地面的中值（Mastcam 块：÷ 本块所在帧中值）：同站内的相对亮度与颜色
格式.rgb_rel_type: rgb_rel_station ÷ 同类各块的几何平均：同类变体之间的颜色差
格式.quality: hole_frac 补洞比例；shadow_frac 每帧都在投射阴影里的格的比例；frames 分离用帧数；illuminations 光照簇数；nframes_med 块内参与的帧数中值；range_m 块中心离车距离；footprint_mm 顺距离方向的像素足迹（近边、中心、远边）；seam_step_log / seam_step_mm 块内帧接缝两侧的反照率（log）/高度（毫米）中位台阶（切块时超过站点 cut.max_seam_step 的候选不要）；shading_leak_r 分离后反照率与明暗模型的高通相关（站级，|r| 越小越干净）

类型说明: 粗糙度：PBR 粗糙度区间（火星地面都很亚光；新鲜磨蚀面最低）。高度混合.对比：0–1，高度混合时这一类边界的硬度（1 = 硬边、盖在高处；0 = 软、填低处）。放置：坡度区间（度）、曲率、相对高程、背风等线索，给程序化生成器挑子类用。现有地类：游戏现有 4 个地类里对应哪一个。程序化=True 的类没有真火星样块。

s0538.name: 三角洲前缘下坡沙地（风成床面）
s0538.note: 批3 到站环拍：5 帧 2576×1936，方位一圈、俯仰约 −30°，同一 sol 下午单一光照。

s0539.name: 下坡沙地大波纹（sol 539 落点）
s0539.note: 批3 到站环拍：5 帧 2576×1936，方位一圈、俯仰约 −30°，同一 sol 下午单一光照。

m105_418.name: Mt Sharp 硫酸盐单元，Gediz Vallis 前的裂隙板（合日期间驻留）
m105_418.note: 好奇号 Navcam 立体 XYZ_F（1024²，CAHVOR，SITE 系）+ RAS_F（全色）。调研：Upper 60% of ncam00400 frame: bright cross-laminated slabs 0.2-1 m with dark sand/granule-filled joints (very clean); lower 30%: dark granule sand; bottom-right: rover wheel + deck hardware (masked in XYZ). 42 identical repeats: 14x each at LTST ~11:02, ~14:04, ~17:21 -> 3 illuminations with noise-averaging. Ring frames sols 3974/3984 add 2 more LTSTs over a wider slab field.（NCAM00400 同一指向 42 次重拍，按 11:0x / 14:0x / 17:2x 三簇各取前 5 帧）

m95_3152.name: Mt Sharp 硫酸盐单元，平整浅色层状基岩（细裂纹）
m95_3152.note: 好奇号 Navcam 立体 XYZ_F（1024²，CAHVOR，SITE 系）+ RAS_F（全色）。调研：az~136 el~-42 frame (ncam00323) repeated at 6 LTSTs (10:06, 10:59, 11:57, 13:44, 14:56, 15:59) over 5 sols: flat light bedrock with hairline fractures + sparse dark sand; right-bottom quarter is rover wheel (masked) and rover shadow at some LTSTs. Distant layered ledges at top (beyond 5 m). Very clean bedrock in left/centre.

m87_2578.name: 黏土–硫酸盐过渡带，平板状层状基岩
m87_2578.note: 好奇号 Navcam 立体 XYZ_F（1024²，CAHVOR，SITE 系）+ RAS_F（全色）。调研：Post-drive ring (5 az) imaged at sols 3088 (~15:19), 3104 (~12:29), 3107 (~12:49): same ground, 3 illuminations; workspace pair at 6 LTSTs but arm/turret intrudes in 3088/3094/3104 frames. Flat platy bedrock with loose slab fragments; very clean beyond rover hardware.

m105_106.name: Gediz Vallis 附近，沙上的棱角块石/卵石场
m105_106.note: 好奇号 Navcam 立体 XYZ_F（1024²，CAHVOR，SITE 系）+ RAS_F（全色）。调研：Angular to subrounded blocks 0.1-1 m, densely packed, with dark sand between; ring sol 3960 ~14:53 plus az~90 frame sol 3961 12:04 (2 illuminations at one pointing). Rover hardware only at ring ends.

m106_660.name: Gediz Vallis 河道边缘：块状碎屑 + 板 + 小沙纹
m106_660.note: 好奇号 Navcam 立体 XYZ_F（1024²，CAHVOR，SITE 系）+ RAS_F（全色）。调研：Two pointings (az~115 & ~149, el -34/-38) each imaged at 09:51, 12:02-12:06, 15:25-15:28, ~16:45 on sol 4116 -> 4 illuminations same sol (no surface change). Mixed scene: tilted laminated slabs, loose blocks, small dark ripples; wheel at right edge of az149 frames. Lower el -> coarser px (~3-5 mm).

m52_1162.name: Bagnold 沙丘 Namib Dune（暗色玄武质沙，沙纹）
m52_1162.note: 好奇号 Navcam 立体 XYZ_F（1024²，CAHVOR，SITE 系）+ RAS_F（全色）。调研：Ring frames sol 1221 16:28 az 30-60 el-47: pristine ripple field (cm-scale ripples clearly resolved) + scoop/wheel scuffs near bottom. Workspace az-23 el-53 at 6 LTSTs (14:01-16:54, sols 1224-1231): upper third pristine ripples, middle has scoop pits/scuffs, lower third rover hardware.

m5_104.name: Rocknest 沙影（颗粒波纹沙席）
m5_104.note: 好奇号 Navcam 立体 XYZ_F（1024²，CAHVOR，SITE 系）+ RAS_F（全色）。调研：Sol 60 12:12-12:13 ring (az 222-312, el -50): smooth sand shadow surface with faint granule ripples, scattered pebbles, wheel tracks; arm in some. Workspace az-15 el-54 over sols 66-93 at many LTSTs but CHIMRA/arm and scoop pits dominate; only pit-free strips usable. Sun el ~80 deg at noon (sol 60) -> low shading contrast.

m2_0.name: Bradbury 着陆点，卵石/颗粒滞留铺面
m2_0.note: 好奇号 Navcam 立体 XYZ_F（1024²，CAHVOR，SITE 系）+ RAS_F（全色）。调研：Very clean pebble/granule pavement over whole frame (az 160-220, el -47); only rover shadow (low sun, 16:12, sun el ~25) and a wheel at frame corner. Single illumination. Landing-site blast zones nearby (Goulburn) - avoid az ~180+ far field.

m89_724.name: Pontours 多边形（六边形）裂纹面
m89_724.note: 好奇号 Navcam 立体 XYZ_F（1024²，CAHVOR，SITE 系）+ RAS_F（全色）。调研：Workspace + 4-frame partial ring, single sol (13:32-13:44), near-identical illumination. Bedrock with mm-cm polygonal texture visible in the test-read RAS NLB_677490876 (see sheets/test_ras_z_NLB_677490876.png) plus white veins and dark sand strips; arm in the az-23 frame.

p7_2050.name: Séítah 边缘的 Máaz 多边形铺路石（合日驻留）
p7_2050.note: 毅力号 Navcam 立体（4 帧全分辨率 / 2 帧半分辨率或 3840 宽）。调研：az70/az142: flat light-toned polygonally fractured paver plates with dark sand in the cracks, ~85% clean; mast/rover shadow in lower-right near field, wheel in az142 corner. az286: dense dark-sand ripple field 4-15 m beyond the rover deck (deck fills lower half). Measured from thumbnails (sheets/A_7-2050.jpg).

p22_788.name: 坑底积尘卵石平原（快速行驶去三角洲途中）
p22_788.note: 毅力号 Navcam 立体（3 帧全分辨率 / 3 帧半分辨率或 3840 宽）。调研：Very uniform fine regolith with mm-cm pebbles, few cobbles; ~90% clean in az235/az306 (morning) and az200/az272 (evening); rover arm/deck in lower-left of az162, mast shadow in az306 lower-right, deck in right half of az344. (sheets/T_22-788.jpg)

p8_0.name: Séítah Brac 露头（Salette/Coulettes 取样）：富橄榄石堆晶岩
p8_0.note: 毅力号 Navcam 立体（0 帧全分辨率 / 5 帧半分辨率或 3840 宽）。调研：Workspace (az53 el-44): upper ~55% is layered/fractured Séítah slabs and dark sand; lower-left is arm/turret/deck (~35%) and arm shadow; sol 253 frames show abrasion patch (white). Ring az94: Séítah slabs + sand, rover shadow+wheel at bottom; az166: sand with ripples + slabs, wheel at bottom. Half-res only. (sheets/A_seitah_8-0.jpg)

p82_2866.name: 坑缘外沙席：颗粒/装甲沙纹（WATSON Elephant_Plains / Lion_Sands 同址）
p82_2866.note: 毅力号 Navcam 立体（0 帧全分辨率 / 4 帧半分辨率或 3840 宽）。调研：Bright sand sheet with low ripples, almost no rocks: >90% clean in az359/az71/az287 apart from wheel/deck at frame edges; low contrast because all Navcam frames are near noon (sun el 62-66). (sheets/E_sand_82-2866.jpg)

p56_1010.name: 坑缘脚下的棱角碎屑（角砾状）
p56_1010.note: 毅力号 Navcam 立体（0 帧全分辨率 / 8 帧半分辨率或 3840 宽）。调研：Dense angular cm-dm clasts of mixed tone on sand/regolith with small light bedrock plates; ~85% clean in workspace upper-right and in ring az210/az198/az270; arm in workspace left third, wheel corners. (sheets/T_56-1010.jpg, R3.jpg)

p52_0.name: Mount Washburn 一带的暗沙床面与块石
p52_0.note: 毅力号 Navcam 立体（4 帧全分辨率 / 0 帧半分辨率或 3840 宽）。调研：az126: rounded sand bedforms (dm-high, m-scale) and troughs filling the frame beyond the turret; az198/az270: sand drift with fine ripples, scattered angular blocks; arm/turret in az126 lower-left, deck in az54. ~70% clean. (sheets/T_52-0.jpg)

p9_2818.name: Séítah 南出口：暗沙、细沙纹与小砾（傍晚/上午两种光照）
p9_2818.note: 毅力号 Navcam 立体（2 帧全分辨率 / 2 帧半分辨率或 3840 宽）。调研：Dark sand with cm ripples, scattered pebbles/cobbles, ~85% clean in az155/az227/az200; old rover tracks at az272/299 (excluded); mast shadow in az155 at 16:38. (sheets/T_9-2818.jpg)

p61_376.name: 坑缘 Witch Hazel Hill 一带：浅色基岩上的暗色棱角卵石/块石（崖锥）
p61_376.note: 毅力号 Navcam 立体（0 帧全分辨率 / 6 帧半分辨率或 3840 宽）。调研：Angular dark clasts 5-60 cm scattered on pale regolith, one 0.5 m boulder in workspace; ~80% clean (arm left third of workspace; rover shadow bottom of az36). (sheets/T_61-376.jpg)
